retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast blue and orange layout featuring abstract highway overpasses and a vertical film strip border for a cinematic jazz aesthetic.
excludeWhen: bright or pastel color schemes are required
organic or hand-drawn illustrations are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A deep blue, monochromatic background composed of overlapping, curved highway overpasses and architectural lines, framed on the left by a vertical film strip. Vibrant orange typography is layered on top, utilizing varying scales and weights to create a clear information hierarchy.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary blue and orange color contrast
Vertical film strip framing the left edge
Dynamic curved lines of overpasses leading the eye diagonally
Layered text over complex geometric background
coreInvariants: Deep navy and slate blue background tones
Vertical film strip element on the left third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title is positioned in the upper center-left, scaled large to dominate the upper half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical film strip on the left provides a stable vertical anchor against the chaotic background curves.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the title from top-left, moves down the right-aligned list of names, and settles on the wide-tracked footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is densely packed with architectural textures and overlapping shapes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and midnight blue background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange for primary and secondary text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light blue and lavender highlights in the background curves
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark background and bright text; low saturation in background vs high saturation in text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated descender on 'J' in the display title
Wide tracking for the bottom-most credit line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with varying weights and tracking to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Vertical film strip with rounded rectangular frames
Abstracted highway overpass photography with motion blur

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and sharp terminals of the title.
Provides the necessary geometric structure for the display and body text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark blue monochromatic background featuring abstract, curved highway overpasses and architectural lines with a vertical film strip border on the left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add orange geometric sans-serif text. Place a large two-line title in the upper left, a right-aligned list of names in the lower right, and a wide-tracked credit line at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the background strictly monochromatic blue?
Is the text a consistent vibrant orange?
Is the film strip present on the left side?
Is the typography a clean geometric sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the film strip border
Tracking width of the footer text

mustAchieve: High legibility of orange text against dark blue

postGenerationChecks: Ensure film strip frames are evenly spaced
Confirm right-alignment of the secondary text block
recipe.reuseFormula: Blue architectural abstract + vertical film strip + orange geometric sans-serif typography.
